summary: Let an agent mark a person update to be spoken with work update --speech

replay.detail: No replay or projection changes; the update object already reaches attention rows unchanged, now with its optional speech.

schema.detail: The update request object (stored in the work.person-asked request field) and the client-v0 PersonUpdate gain optional speech, 1 to 300 characters. No table, claim kind or rules version changes.

rules.detail: Only an update carries speech; the existing rule that an update is about the person's own run, step or message is unchanged. Updates the daemon posts when an ask ends carry no speech.

compatibility.detail: Additive: older clients ignore update.speech. A daemon that predates this field refuses a request carrying it with invalid-person-request, so roll daemons before agents use work update --speech. The Rust, TypeScript and Swift SDKs expose PersonUpdate.speech.

downtime.detail: No service restart or coordinated upgrade required.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the flag and field; stored updates that carry speech stay readable as ordinary updates.
